critical_code_review_comments: Admin users endpoints correctly use app_users collection (mobile app customers), separate from system users collection
User list endpoint supports comprehensive filtering: search (name/email/phone/user_id), membership_type (free/premium/vip), status (active/suspended), register_by (phone/email/google)
Stats summary endpoint provides complete breakdown: total, active, suspended, premium, free, trial_active, by_registration
User detail endpoint returns all profile fields including trial info, devices, favorites, playlists, recently_played
Listening history endpoint enriches sessions with song and album details
Transactions endpoint checks both transactions and payments collections as fallback
Create user generates default password hash and sets register_by='admin'
Delete user also cleans up user_tokens and listening_sessions collections
Update user correctly maps frontend 'membership_type' to backend 'subscription_type'
